title: 工業力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics I
teachers:
SEGAWA Akio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn the basic concepts of the static mechanics.
(2) learn what kind of forces act on the rigid bodies.
(3) learn how to calculate the balance condition of forces.
(4) learn how to calculate the center of gravity.
advice:
This is a basic engineering mechanics course.
We will cover the following materials:
1. Force
2. Synthesis and decomposition of forces
3. Moments of forces
4. Balance of forces
5. Center of gravity of rigid bodies
Students will also learn about advanced issues not included in the textbooks.
Students will be expected to understand the meanings of the terms and formulas.
Students will be expected to solve the exercises on their own.
Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of lectures, quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
Students should not be absent from the class, as the handouts may be not received.

activityGoals.body: Be able to indicate the forces on the rigid bodies and to describe their magnitude using SI unit correctly
Be able to synthesize and decompose the forces
Be able to calculate the moments of forces

Be able to calculate the center of gravity for the rigid bodies

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Synthesize the forces acting at the same points and in the different directions.
(2) Decompose the forces in any directions and synthesize the forces acting at the different points and in the different directions.
(3) Calculate the moments of force on the actual rigid bodies.
(4) Calculate local loads on the actual rigid bodies from the balance of forces.
(5) Calculate the center of gravity of the actual rigid bodies.
(6) Evaluate the stability of the actual rigid bodies.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain the three elements to indicate the force vectors, and describe the forces using SI unit.
(2) Decompose the forces into the x and y axis and synthesize three forces acting at the different points.
(3) Calculate the moments of force acting on the rigid bodies, and indicate them in suitable SI units.
(4) Calculate the reaction forces at the rotational support points.
(5) Calculate the center of gravity of objects composed of the simple rigid bodies.
(6) Evaluate the stability of the simple rigid bodies.
